title: 3219. Minimum Cost for Cutting Cake II

examples.explanation: Perform a cut on the vertical line 0 with cost 5, current total cost is 5. Perform a cut on the horizontal line 0 on 3 x 1 subgrid with cost 1. Perform a cut on the horizontal line 0 on 3 x 1 subgrid with cost 1. Perform a cut on the horizontal line 1 on 2 x 1 subgrid with cost 3. Perform a cut on the horizontal line 1 on 2 x 1 subgrid with cost 3. The total cost is 5 + 1 + 1 + 3 + 3 = 13.

Perform a cut on the horizontal line 0 with cost 7. Perform a cut on the vertical line 0 on 1 x 2 subgrid with cost 4. Perform a cut on the vertical line 0 on 1 x 2 subgrid with cost 4. The total cost is 7 + 4 + 4 = 15.
